vrf definition CUSTOMER-A
 rd 65000:100
 !
 address-family ipv4
  route-target export 65000:100
  route-target import 65000:100
 exit-address-family
!
interface GigabitEthernet1
 description Customer A handoff
 vrf forwarding CUSTOMER-A
!
ip route vrf CUSTOMER-A 203.0.113.0 255.255.255.0 192.0.2.10
router bgp 65000
 address-family ipv4 vrf CUSTOMER-A
  neighbor 192.0.2.20 remote-as 65100
 exit-address-family
!
